privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Climweb Weather App is developed by WMO-RAF (World Meteorological Organisation - Regional Office for Africa) and Norway MET (Meteorologisk institutt). We are committed to protecting your privacy.

dataCollected.title: Information We Collect
dataCollected.text: Climweb Weather App does not collect, store, or share any personal information. You do not need to register or provide any personal details to use the app.

location.title: Use of Location Data
location.text: To show you accurate weather forecasts and alerts for your area, the app uses your device's location. Your location is used only to fetch weather data for that spot and is not linked to your identity or stored on our servers.

favourites.title: Your Favourite Places
favourites.text: If you save favourite places, they are stored only on your device. This information is never sent to us or shared with anyone else. You can add, change, or remove your favourite places at any time from Favourites on the More tab.

security.title: Data Security
security.text: We take data security seriously. Since we do not collect or store personal data, our focus is on keeping the app's forecast and alert services accurate and reliable.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.text: Climweb Weather App is designed to be used by people of all ages, including children. We do not collect personal information from children or any other users.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.text: The app may contain links to third-party websites or services that we do not operate. If you tap a third-party link, you will be taken to that third party's site. We encourage you to read their privacy policies, as we are not responsible for their content or practices.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact WMO-RAF (World Meteorological Organisation - Regional Office for Africa) or Norway MET (Meteorologisk institutt).
